title: INDOPREF: A Multi-Domain Pairwise Preference Dataset for Indonesian
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmark, INDOPREF, is designed to evaluate the naturalness and quality of LLM-generated text in Indonesian across 10 diverse categories: Analysis, Brainstorming, Coding, Creative Writing, Logic, Math, Open Question, Safety, Summarization, and Translation.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research.
